authorization: The user explicitly authorized a no-training successor that first freezes a reproducible 32D clean-direct baseline and only then executes the unchanged single-P time-role decomposition on the existing 3011--3013 checkpoints.
question: Within one eager float32 32D clean-direct arithmetic authority, why is clean single-P seed 3011 sensitive to removing normalized time: is its registered Ce probability deficit removable by one label-free margin scale, where does explicit time enter the frozen control, and do no-time networks express state-dependent plasticity beyond absolute support position?
claim_boundary: This successor repairs an arithmetic-authority problem, not a scientific result. The predecessor remains noninterpretable and the parent clean_single_p outcome remains time_removal_failure.
The direct-authority baseline is a new internally self-consistent coordinate system. It is not required or permitted to claim identity between direct and legacy-adapter internal P states.
External compatibility requires faithful reproduction of the parent's observable endpoint values and every registered scientific classification; it cannot revise the parent outcome or thresholds.
No checkpoint, seed, panel, input, task stream, endpoint, intervention, probe, threshold, or model parameter may be selected or changed from a baseline or mechanism result.

The scientific estimands and interpretation boundaries of single_p_time_role_decomposition_v1 are inherited unchanged. A successful diagnostic cannot promote a model, establish a human or biological mechanism, or establish population prevalence from three networks.

scientific_estimands.inherited: The canonical field, Stage 1--3 estimands, resampling, thresholds, labels, unconditional execution rule, and scientific claim boundaries are inherited verbatim except where this protocol replaces the failed dual-arithmetic integrity design.

design.checkpoint_rule: Use exactly the checkpoints selected by the parent model lock, with the parent's clean or noisy training arm required by each cell.
design.input_rule: Use exactly the generic and Liu inputs selected by the parent repaired source lock, with the parent's clean or noisy observation arm required by each cell.
design.no_training: No optimizer construction, gradient, parameter update, checkpoint selection, or new random training state is permitted.
design.one_arithmetic_authority: The 32D clean-direct model implementation, input assembly, recurrent step, support replay, query reader, dtype, device mode, and execution semantics are the sole internal-state authority for baseline terminal P, selected prefix P, interventions, probes, and margins.
design.legacy_adapter_boundary: The legacy parent adapter may be read only as an external observable reference through frozen parent raw arrays and results. Its hidden state, eligibility, local state, P, storage summaries, and call graph are never an internal-state reference and are never executed by this study.

runtime.model_execution: CUDA eager float32 for every baseline, intervention, trajectory, probe, and query operation.
runtime.determinism: Enable deterministic Torch algorithms, disable cuDNN benchmarking, set float32 matmul precision to highest, fix one Torch interop thread, one Torch intraop thread, and one BLAS/compiler thread, and record the complete environment and device identity.
runtime.statistics: CPU float64 with the inherited 2000-draw paired or clustered resampling and equal-panel aggregation.
runtime.same_process_replay: For each baseline execution unit, compute the required direct outputs twice in one process from independently loaded immutable inputs and fresh model execution state. Required arrays must be bitwise identical, including dtype, shape, finite mask, and bytes.
runtime.failure: Any nondeterminism, mode drift, source mismatch, nonfinite required value, mutation, shape mismatch, or gate failure stops the applicable phase without mechanism interpretation.

phase_1_direct_authority_baseline.scope: All 72 seed-by-panel-by-condition-by-cell units, with no mechanism intervention or mechanism estimator imported or executed.
external_outputs: all generic original-query margins, targets, learned masks, correct probabilities, cross-entropy values, and write/storage inputs required by the parent summaries
all Liu intact, P-off, evidence-shuffle, and leave-one-relation-out observable margins required to recompute endpoints, evidence binding, routes, and core classifications
all panel summaries, equal-panel aggregates, compensation components, per-seed decisions, 3011 Ce five-endpoint noninferiority, and the overall parent outcome
internal_artifacts: terminal P and direct query fields/margins for every Ce generic batch and Liu cohort in both architecture conditions
P_0 through P_T for the prospectively selected Ce Stage-3 generic episodes in both architecture conditions
direct query fields/margins for A0, Ae, and C0 needed by the frozen Stage-1 secondary geometry
phase_1_direct_authority_baseline.stage_3_selection: Within each seed, panel, condition, and support length 28, 32, 36, or 40, select the two smallest frozen generic episode_indices before reading any new result, exactly as in the predecessor protocol.
phase_1_direct_authority_baseline.artifact_format: Write deterministic typed NPZ members with allow_pickle=False semantics under the ignored runtime root. Use stable logical identities, explicit dtype/shape metadata, member SHA-256, and one aggregate artifact manifest; never store Python objects.
phase_1_direct_authority_baseline.self_reproducibility_gate: Every required terminal P, selected prefix P trajectory, direct field, margin, and external-analysis raw array must be bitwise identical between the two same-process direct replays. No numerical fallback tolerance is allowed.

external_array_gate.margins: Direct intact generic and Liu margins must match frozen parent raw margins with atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-5, with identical shapes and finite masks.
external_array_gate.probability_and_ce: Recomputed per-episode or per-subject generic probabilities, generic CE, and Liu learned, nonlearned, and omitted correct probabilities must have identical missingness masks and maximum absolute error at most 1e-10 against the frozen parent raw arrays.
external_array_gate.summary_points: Every finite parent panel or equal-panel point estimate used by competence, evidence binding, core, compensation, and Ce noninferiority must have absolute error at most 1e-8.
external_array_gate.classifications: Every panel competence and evidence-binding flag, Ae/Ce full-route core flag, compensation component, Ce five-endpoint noninferiority flag, per-seed decision, and overall outcome must match exactly. The overall outcome must remain time_removal_failure.

phase_1_direct_authority_baseline.forbidden_comparison: Do not compare direct terminal P, prefix P, hidden state, eligibility, local state, or storage summaries to the adapter or use adapter-derived values to accept, reject, calibrate, replace, or modify a direct internal artifact.
phase_outcomes: baseline_compatible: all source, runtime, bitwise self-reproducibility, external array, summary, and classification gates pass
baseline_incompatible: any gate fails; freeze the failure record, perform no mechanism execution, preserve the parent result, and stop

required_before_mechanism: a committed qualification record produced only from synthetic non-scientific fixtures
a committed source/input/checkpoint/environment lock for the baseline implementation
a committed baseline compatibility result containing all gate outcomes but no mechanism estimates
a committed content-addressed artifact lock covering every runtime baseline NPZ member and its aggregate manifest
a clean Git witness commit containing the protocol, qualification, source lock, baseline result, and artifact lock
baseline_freeze.immutability: The mechanism phase must verify the committed baseline result and every locked runtime member before reading arrays. Missing, extra, changed, regenerated, or partially rewritten baseline artifacts are fatal. Baseline execution may not be rerun after its result is exposed within this study.
baseline_freeze.authorization_gate: Only baseline_compatible authorizes mechanism execution. A compatible baseline does not itself authorize any scientific label.

phase_2_mechanism.entry: Load and verify the frozen direct-authority baseline result and artifact lock. Baseline terminal P, selected prefix P, original fields, and original margins must come only from those locked artifacts; the mechanism phase may not regenerate them.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_1: Execute the predecessor's unchanged final-margin Hodge decomposition and positive scalar estimand. Fit one label-free positive scalar on panel-1 Ce generic plus Liu canonical fields per seed; test the five Ce endpoints on panels 2--3 with the inherited lower95>=-0.02 rule; report mandatory A0, Ae, C0 context.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_2: For Ce time-retained controls, replay reverse, deterministic deranged, and mean-clamped support schedules through the same direct eager step path and compare them with locked original terminal P and fields. For query-time interventions, clone locked original terminal P, change only query time, and prohibit P writeback. Execute full generic and Liu cohorts for all seeds and panels.
phase_2_mechanism.stage_3: For both Ce architecture conditions, load locked P_0 through P_T for the selected episodes, compute the unchanged prefix geometry and natural effective writes, and apply the exhaustive fixed pair-by-evidence probe battery from clones through the same direct eager step and query path. Probes must not mutate locked or natural trajectories.
phase_2_mechanism.unconditional_rule: Once admitted to Phase 2, execute all inherited Stage 1--3 estimands for all registered seeds and panels regardless of intermediate scientific values. Only an integrity failure may stop execution.
labels: mechanism_heterogeneous when the inherited descriptive condition holds
noninterpretable only for a Phase-2 source, artifact, isolation, mutation, runtime, or numerical-integrity failure
phase_2_mechanism.interpretation: Report simultaneous labels rather than a global pass. Keep scale sufficiency distinct from parameter equivalence, acute time-path interventions distinct from training without time, state dependence distinct from a confidence link, and all model-level findings distinct from human or biological mechanisms.

qualification.scope: Before any registered baseline output is exposed, use only synthetic non-scientific fixtures to verify direct replay bitwise identity, deterministic NPZ round-trip and hashing, no adapter dependency in internal-state code, field and endpoint reconstruction, artifact-lock completeness, baseline reader immutability, intervention isolation, prefix clone isolation, probe nonmutation, and the inherited pure estimators.
qualification.source_lock: After qualification, lock the committed protocol and implementation sources, qualification result, parent authorities, every selected checkpoint and input, parent raw external references, environment, command, and Git witness before Phase 1.
qualification.separation_test: Qualification must assert that the Phase-1 command cannot import or invoke mechanism estimators and that the Phase-2 command refuses to run without a compatible committed baseline lock.

freeze_points: Freeze point 1: commit this protocol and its study registration before implementing estimators or exposing any direct-authority baseline output; then qualify and lock the baseline source before Phase 1.

Freeze point 2: after a compatible Phase-1 result, commit the baseline compatibility result and content-addressed artifact lock before Phase 2; Phase 2 may only read that frozen baseline and use the same arithmetic authority.
execution.retention: Track compact contracts, locks, compatibility and mechanism results, sufficient numerical summaries, and the report. Retain the large content-addressed direct baseline under the ignored runtime root according to its artifact lock. Parent checkpoints and inputs remain governed by the parent retention boundary.
